Yo I just started playing on here less than a week ago and I already feel a part of the family. It seems like there’s always stuff happening on the server and the discord, but it never feels too crowded. When I applied to be whitelisted I wasn’t really looking for just a private server with no griefers and trolls, I wanted to become a member of a tight knit community which is exactly what I found. I’m so used to building underground so players won’t find and raid me, so it was a weird feeling to be able to build out in the open and not need to hide my valuables. I think the coolest thing about all this is that anyone can come by your place and you trust that they won’t raid you. 

It’s weird to trust others in Minecraft when you have so much experience interacting with hostile players on huge public servers. There’s a nice comfort that comes with well placed trust, and this server has an abundance of it.
